habitat: Gypsum hillside and adjacent flat surrounded by limestone derived soils. Limestone soils have a noticeably different flora, although there is some overlap floristically between the two substrates. Gypsum substrates contain a number of gypsum endemics. Selaginella gypsophila is common. Conditions good.
locality: Along gravel road leading NE of road  from La Escondida to Aramberri.
name: Verbesina zaragosana var. zaragosana
occurrenceRemarks: Collected for the project “Origin and Evolution of the Chihuahuan Desert Gypsum Endemic Flora”.
